sources.claim: Decimal rate factors: Mbps=1000000 bit/s; Gbps=1000000000 bit/s.
Dimensionless ratio, addition and signed difference; not a queueing or traffic collection model.
Threshold belongs to the operator; no universal utilization recommendation is supplied.

formulas.expression: observed sum = sum of supplied mutually exclusive application rates
headroom = capacity − current sum; percentage = 100 − current utilization
No input => NOT_CONFIGURED; current percent >= threshold => AT_OR_ABOVE; otherwise BELOW
Missing optional values remain null; incomplete observed sums disclose supplied count / row count
Individual peak sum is an envelope; timestamps are not modeled
